tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Extend existing JSONL adapter with duplicate_headers="last"|"error"|"suffix" via formatter kwargs. Default last preserves old output; error rejects duplicate names before consuming a row; suffix creates deterministic collision-free names _2,_3,... while reserving every original name so real columns such as a_2 are not overwritten. Materialize one-shot headers once, keep row width validation and both unicode modes, preserve input header sequence and per-call formatter defaults. Explicit policies require text names.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_ch_json_headers_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-ch-json-headers-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Extend JSONL adapter with decimal_policy="float"|"string" and strict_json=False. Keep old defaults. String policy encodes every Decimal (including nested ones) as exact decimal text preserving scale; strict mode rejects nonfinite Decimal and float values anywhere, including string-policy Decimal NaN. Use per-call encoder settings without changing global JSON encoder state, preserve ordinary strings, large integers, unicode modes and input values, and reject invalid policy arguments before reading rows.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_ch_json_precision_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-ch-json-precision-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Add spreadsheet_formula_policy(data,headers,formula_policy="preserve",**kwargs) preprocessor. Treat string cells/headers whose leading-whitespace-trimmed text begins =,+,-,@ as formula-like. Preserve default; escape prefixes one apostrophe to the exact original string; error raises with only one-based data row/column (header row zero), without exposing contents. Keep numeric negatives/nonstrings unchanged, operate lazily without mutating inputs and integrate through real CSV formatter preprocessors. Per-call policy must not leak to subsequent exports. Do not claim sanitization for every spreadsheet engine or rollback lines already consumed before a later error.
